text:
Type: white ceramic plant pot
Use: holding a potted houseplant on a windowsill, shelf or table; living room, home office, kitchen
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: glazed ceramic with an embossed relief pattern, glossy finish
Colors: bright white
Shape: tapered cylinder that widens toward the rim, raised relief designs such as vertical ribs, horizontal bands or wavy lines, small and simple
Feel: fresh, clean, bright, tidy
Goes with: green plants, herbs, light wood shelves, white kitchens; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms
